issues: 同一张项目页甩到同一张页的另一块，换景前后几乎一样，看不出"功能段连打"
满屏浅色截图、没有任何标题文字，暂停任何一帧都只是一张网页
只有一次甩动，节奏单调；甩动时整屏单层平移，没有纵深
全片无强调色、无舞台光
changes: look 换成 lime 酸柠夜：横向长舞台并排三个功能段，每段 = 112px 两行大标题（关键词酸柠色）+ 等宽序号 01/03 + 右侧产品窗口（项目板 / 周报正文 / 论文雷达真实纹理）
节奏改为两次 8f 甩镜连打 A→B→C（hold 28f / 36f / 46f），每甩 2880px、峰值 ~680px/f，借糊帧换景、甩完即停
三层视差：标题层 1.14×、窗口层 1×、标题背后巨型描边序号 0.55×，每层按自己的瞬时速度挂方向性拖影，静止段零滤镜
底部三段进度条随落点点亮当前段；描边序号只显示当前段，不从窗口边露出邻段
issuesEn: It whipped from one part of the projects page to another part of the same page, so before and after looked almost identical and it did not read as a run of features
Full-frame light screenshots with no titles: any paused frame was just a web page
A single whip made the rhythm monotonous, and the whole frame panned as one flat layer with no depth
No accent colour and no stage light anywhere
changesEn: Lime night look: three feature sections side by side on a long horizontal stage, each with a 112px two-line headline (key words in lime), a mono 01/03 index and a product window on the right (projects board, weekly report body, paper radar, all real textures)
The rhythm is now two back-to-back 8f whips A to B to C (holds of 28f, 36f and 46f), each covering 2880px at a ~680px/f peak, swapping scenes on the blur frames and stopping dead
Three parallax layers: headlines at 1.14x, windows at 1x and giant outlined indices behind the headlines at 0.55x, each with directional blur from its own speed and no filters while still
A three-part progress bar at the bottom lights the current section on landing; the outlined index only shows for the current section so neighbours never peek past the window edge
